title: Nexatech – E-Commerce Platform
description: Scalable e-commerce system using Micro Frontend (Next.js Module Federation) and Microservice patterns, with independently deployable services (Auth, Blog, Host App). Features user authentication, product catalog, shopping cart, order management, blog module, and admin dashboard.

title: Techflu – Tech Rental Platform (B2B & B2C)
description: Production-grade B2B & B2C tech rental platform with separate User, Admin, and Delivery Partner panels. Built scalable rental workflows including cart, booking, payments, KYC verification, order management, delivery operations, notifications, and automated subscription handling. Implemented Razorpay & PhonePe integrations with AutoPay support, Redis caching, BullMQ queues, cron jobs, and event-driven order processing. Developed secure media upload architecture using pre-signed AWS S3 upload URLs, Aadhaar & address proof verification using Digio, and Google Maps integration for delivery tracking and OTP-based verification. Admin panel supports product management, specifications, KYC approvals, delivery partner onboarding, order assignment, lead management, and centralized activity logs across users, orders, and deliveries.

title: Self-Hosted Home Server Platform
description: Built a personal self-hosted cloud infrastructure platform using an old laptop as a dedicated home server to deploy and manage full-stack applications and backend services. Designed a production-style hosting environment with Docker-based containerized deployments, Nginx reverse proxy routing, Cloudflare secure public access, and MinIO S3-compatible object storage. Implemented backend deployment pipelines with environment variable and secret file management, along with self-hosted alternatives for services similar to Vercel and Supabase. Focused on networking, scalability, infrastructure automation, storage management, and secure service exposure for hosting personal projects and APIs.

title: Cloudverse – Cloud Management & FinOps Platform
description: Contributed to a cloud management and FinOps platform by developing the Chargeback module for enterprise cloud cost allocation and financial analytics. Built scalable backend services for pool-based cost allocation, direct/shared cost distribution, Reserved Instance (RI) and Savings Plan (SP) allocations, and ledger-based cost tracking across organizational cost centers. Implemented automated ledger generation and cost processing workflows using scheduled jobs and analytics pipelines. Focused on designing reliable backend architectures and optimized financial data processing using NestJS, Prisma ORM, PostgreSQL, Redis, ClickHouse, GraphQL, and Apache Airflow.

title: AuraML – Multi-Tenant SaaS & Identity Platform
description: Developed a scalable multi-tenant SaaS identity and access management platform enabling organizations to manage employees, teams, and product access through a unified authentication ecosystem. Built centralized authentication and authorization workflows using Keycloak with multi-tenant realm architecture, RBAC, SSO, LDAP integration, and secure identity federation. Implemented organization-level user management, role-based permissions, subscription-based and token-based product access, wallet systems, and Razorpay payment integration for seamless cross-product experiences. Designed scalable backend services and APIs using Django and PostgreSQL, while developing responsive frontend interfaces with React.js. Focused heavily on authentication architecture, tenant isolation, identity management, secure session handling, and enterprise-grade access control systems.

title: Realm – Real Estate Mobile Application
description: Developed a cross-platform real estate mobile application for Android and iOS enabling users to explore residential and commercial properties, view property details, and schedule appointments with property dealers. Built the mobile application using Ionic Capacitor with support for native Android and iOS deployments through Android Studio and Xcode. Worked on mobile UI flows, API integrations, authentication, property listing management, appointment booking workflows, and production deployment processes. Focused on responsive mobile experiences, cross-platform compatibility, and scalable frontend-mobile integration.

title: Reusable Multi-Tenant Identity Platform (IDP)
description: Built a scalable multi-tenant Identity Provider (IDP) platform for centralized authentication, authorization, and user management across multiple applications and clients. Developed secure APIs for login, signup, OTP verification, password authentication, token management, and session handling. Implemented RBAC-based access control, client-based architecture, tenant isolation, and centralized identity management for scalable SaaS environments. Designed the system with production-grade backend architecture using Redis caching, Kafka-based event-driven communication, asynchronous processing, and scalable authentication workflows. Worked on advanced enterprise authentication capabilities including SSO, LDAP integration, and secure identity federation while focusing on scalability, security, and maintainability.

title: Chatly – Real-time Messaging Platform
description: Scalable real-time messaging platform supporting 1–1 and group chat with Spring Boot, WebSocket (STOMP), PostgreSQL, MongoDB, and Redis. Mobile client built with React Native (Expo). Features real-time messaging, presence & typing indicators, media upload (S3), and read receipts.

title: Aurora Hotel Management
description: Enterprise-grade hotel management platform with AI-powered RAG chatbot using Google Gemini, RBAC with 70+ permissions, multi-branch management, booking system, and comprehensive analytics dashboard.

title: CodeHub Platform
description: Modern platform for developers to share, discover, and collaborate on code snippets with secure authentication, 70+ language support, real-time collaboration, and notification system.

title: NatureGrain E-commerce
description: Premium organic food e-commerce platform with product browsing, shopping cart, JWT authentication, admin dashboard for inventory and analytics.

title: SoleStore Footwear
description: Modern footwear e-commerce with product filtering, shopping cart, wishlist, order history, and efficient admin system.

title: HuongBien Restaurant
description: Desktop system for restaurant operations with table reservations, customer loyalty, billing, employee management, and revenue analytics.

title: Portfolio Website
description: Modern portfolio with React 19, TailwindCSS 4, Three.js animations, SEO optimization, and responsive design.
